records.name: Freelance graphic designer (contests and 1-to-1 projects)
records.summary: Apply to join 99designs as a designer, then compete in client design contests or take paid 1-to-1 projects such as logos and branding.

records.name: Stock photo, video & illustration contributor
records.summary: Sell licences to your photos, videos, vectors and illustrations through Adobe Stock and earn a share of each sale.

records.name: AI response evaluation and rating (category)
records.summary: Remote gig work rating, ranking and rewriting chatbot or search outputs so AI companies can improve their models.

records.name: Freelance AI training specialist (Alignerr)
records.summary: Labelbox-run marketplace that hires freelance generalists and experts by the hour to train and evaluate AI models.

records.name: AppleCare At Home Advisor (Canada)
records.summary: Apple's At Home Advisor remote support role has had Canadian postings in the past, but none were found open in Canada now.

records.name: Virtual assistant contractor (BELAY)
records.summary: BELAY is a US virtual-assistant staffing firm whose contractor roles are open only to residents of certain US states, not Canada.

records.name: Better Jobs Ontario (funded retraining for laid-off or long-unemployed people)
records.summary: Ontario grant that can cover tuition, books, transportation and a basic living allowance while an eligible laid-off or long-unemployed person trains for an in-demand job.
audience: People in Ontario who were laid off or have been unemployed for a long stretch

records.name: Bilingual English–French work (category)
records.summary: Using English–French bilingualism for translation, interpretation, localization review, tutoring or bilingual service work — a distinctly Canadian advantage with an earnings premium that is strongest in Quebec.

records.name: Online English conversation tutor
records.summary: Chat with English learners over video on Cambly for a fixed per-minute rate; native English speakers 18+ can apply without teaching credentials, but intake of new tutors is currently limited.

records.name: Canada Summer Jobs (youth summer jobs, ages 15-30)
records.organization: Government of Canada - Employment and Social Development Canada
records.summary: Federally funded summer jobs for people aged 15 to 30, posted on Job Bank each spring; the 2026 hiring period has ended.

records.name: Canadian freelance job boards and freelancer associations
records.summary: Canada-focused places to find freelance and contract postings (especially writing, editing and communications) and groups that support freelancers.

records.name: Canva template creator
records.summary: Design templates for Canva's library and earn monthly royalties based on how often Canva users use them. You get in through a portfolio application, and the program is listed as being in beta.

records.name: Customer service / tech support representative (Concentrix Canada)
records.summary: Concentrix hires customer service and tech support reps in Canada, but recent Canadian postings seen are hybrid or on-site; remote Canadian postings found are old.

records.name: Content moderation / online safety evaluation (category)
records.summary: Reviewing posts, videos or search results against safety rules; some evaluator versions are part-time freelance work from home.

records.name: Commission-free freelance portfolio and payments (Contra)
records.summary: Show a portfolio, find or bring your own clients, and get paid without Contra taking a commission from your earnings.

records.name: Contact centre agent, seasonal/term (Canada Revenue Agency)
records.summary: The CRA hires temporary call-centre agents each year to answer taxpayers' phone questions, ramping up before tax season.

records.name: AI data project contributor (CrowdGen by Appen)
records.summary: Appen's contributor platform where you apply to individual AI data projects, some of them reserved for Canada residents.

records.name: Canadian French voice-rating and speech data tasks
records.summary: Short online projects where native Canadian French speakers located in Canada rate computer-generated voices or audio for AI training through Appen's CrowdGen platform.

records.name: AI chatbot evaluator and writer (DataAnnotation)
records.summary: Online platform that pays contributors to rate chatbot answers, write and check code for AI training, paid via PayPal.

records.name: Digital Service Squad member (Digital Main Street, Ontario)
records.summary: Paid squad roles helping Ontario main-street small businesses get online through free one-on-one support. Digital Main Street hires them in Toronto, and local BIAs or municipalities hire them when they have grant funding.

records.name: Diary studies and video missions (dscout)
records.summary: Join occasional paid research 'missions' where you record short videos and answer questions on your phone; this is not a job.

records.name: Ecommerce operations support: orders, returns & product listings (category)
records.summary: Behind-the-scenes work for online stores: processing orders, handling returns and shipping claims, and creating or updating product listings and feeds on Shopify, Amazon and other marketplaces.

records.name: Paid election worker (municipal, provincial or federal elections)
records.summary: Short-term paid jobs staffing voting places for municipal, provincial or federal elections; hiring happens in the weeks or months before each vote.

records.name: Employment Ontario employment services (free job-search help)
records.organization: Government of Ontario - Employment Ontario (local service providers)
records.summary: Free one-on-one job-search help in Ontario (resumes, interview prep, job matching and referrals to funded training) through more than 700 local Employment Ontario locations.

records.name: Accessibility tester with lived disability experience (Fable)
records.summary: Toronto-founded company that pays people with disabilities who use assistive technology to test websites and apps for accessibility.
audience: People who use assistive technology (lived disability experience)

records.name: Film & TV production assistant (category)
records.summary: Entry-level crew work on film, TV and commercial sets, sometimes reached through short crew-training programs. Job Bank files production assistants under NOC 53111.

records.name: Selling freelance service 'gigs' on Fiverr
records.summary: List fixed-price service packages ('gigs') that buyers can order directly; Fiverr keeps 20% of each sale.

records.name: Work-at-home customer service representative (Foundever Canada)
records.summary: Foundever, a global customer-service outsourcer (formerly Sitel), hires work-from-home customer service representatives in Canada, with company equipment and benefits.

records.name: Bidding on projects at Freelancer.com
records.summary: Bid on client projects posted to Freelancer.com's marketplace; the platform takes a fee on each project you're awarded.

records.name: Freelance transcriptionist (multi-language)
records.summary: Freelance transcription work for GoTranscript in English or many other languages, paid per audio minute after a quiz and audio-sample test.

records.name: Seasonal tax expert, work from home (Intuit TurboTax Canada)
records.summary: Intuit hires experienced tax preparers anywhere in Canada as seasonal remote employees to help TurboTax Live customers from January to April.

records.name: Online language teacher / community tutor
records.summary: Teach languages on italki as a Community Tutor (native or near-native, no credential) or a certified Professional Teacher, setting your own price; italki takes a 15–30% commission on paid lessons.

records.name: Job Bank job search and alerts (Government of Canada)
records.summary: Free federal job board where you can search Canadian job postings, set daily email alerts and check typical wages for an occupation, without creating an account.

records.name: Over-the-phone interpreter (Indigenous languages, Canada)
records.summary: Work-from-home phone interpreting between English and Indigenous languages such as Cree or Inuktitut for LanguageLine, as an independent contractor paid per call minute.
audience: People fluent in English and an Indigenous language such as Cree or Inuktitut

records.name: Paid online surveys (Leger LEO panel)
records.summary: Answer market-research surveys for points you can redeem for cash, travel miles or gift cards; legitimate, but the earnings look too small to recommend as a way to earn.

records.name: AI output evaluator / domain expert (Mercor)
records.summary: AI-training marketplace that contracts generalists and professionals at hourly rates to judge AI outputs; some roles are open specifically to US and Canada residents.

records.name: NPower Canada Junior IT Analyst Program (free IT training)
records.summary: Free 15-week beginner IT training, with the Google IT Support Professional Certificate and job-search support, for young adults facing barriers to work.

records.name: ODSP Employment Supports (job help for people with a disability)
records.organization: Government of Ontario - Ontario Disability Support Program
records.summary: Ontario employment help (job coaching, job placement and on-the-job supports) for people whose long-term disability makes finding or keeping work harder; you do not need to receive ODSP income support.
audience: Ontario residents with a disability or long-term health condition

records.name: Pre-apprenticeship training (free trade-readiness programs, Ontario)
records.organization: Government of Ontario (delivered by colleges and community agencies)
records.summary: Free Ontario programs of up to 52 weeks, including an 8-12 week work placement, that help people without trade experience get ready to land an apprenticeship.

records.name: Registered apprenticeship in a skilled trade (Ontario)
records.summary: Earn-while-you-learn route into a skilled trade: you work for a sponsor and register a training agreement with Skilled Trades Ontario.

records.name: AI trainer / response evaluator (Outlier)
records.summary: Scale AI's freelance platform where contributors write, rate and correct AI chatbot answers for hourly pay.

records.name: Online tutor (languages and other subjects)
records.summary: Set your own rate and teach one-on-one video lessons on the Preply marketplace; Preply keeps the whole first trial lesson with each new student and 18–33% of later lessons.

records.name: Paid online research studies (Prolific)
records.summary: Take part in paid online research studies when you match a study's criteria; this is research participation, not a job.

records.name: Proofreading & copyediting (category)
records.summary: Checking and correcting other people's writing for errors, clarity and style, as an employee or freelancer; a recognized Canadian occupation with a national association and certification.

records.name: Government student and new-grad job programs (FSWEP, Ontario SEO, Ontario Internship Program)
records.summary: Federal and Ontario public-service hiring streams reserved for students (FSWEP, Ontario Summer Employment Opportunities) and recent graduates (Ontario Internship Program).

records.name: Remote appointment setting & scheduling (category)
records.summary: Calling businesses or customers from home to check their interest and book meetings for a sales team, paid by salary, hourly wage or per booked lead.

records.name: Remote call-centre, chat & email customer support (category)
records.summary: Work-from-home customer service jobs answering customers by phone, chat or email for retailers, outsourcers and other companies across Canada.

records.name: Paid research interviews and focus groups (Respondent)
records.summary: Apply to paid interviews, focus groups and surveys that companies run with consumers and professionals; this is research participation, not a job.

records.name: Freelance transcriptionist / captioner
records.summary: Transcribe or caption audio and video files from Rev's work queue and get paid per audio minute; new applicants currently face a waitlist.

records.name: Freelance academic editor / proofreader
records.summary: Edit and proofread students' academic papers for Scribbr at fixed per-word rates; requires native-level English and a university degree.

records.name: Merchant Support Advisor (Shopify, Canada)
records.summary: Shopify, a Canadian ecommerce platform that works remotely, hires Merchant Support Advisors in Canada to help store owners with their Shopify shops.

records.name: Shopify Partner Program (freelance store setup & referrals)
records.summary: A free program for freelancers and agencies who build or manage Shopify stores for clients, which pays a recurring revenue share while referred merchants stay on paid plans.

records.name: Stock photo, video & illustration contributor
records.summary: Upload your photos, video clips or illustrations to Shutterstock's library and earn a percentage each time a customer licenses one.

records.name: Remote TV & movie metadata editor
records.summary: A freelance contract role researching, writing and checking TV and movie listings data for a Copenhagen-based metadata company. A Canada posting listed CAD 20/hour for a full-time allocation.

records.name: Digital help for local small businesses (category)
records.summary: Freelance help for local shops and services with simple digital jobs: website updates, Google Business Profile listings, basic social posts and online-store setup.

records.name: Social media coordinator / community manager (category)
records.summary: Planning, posting and monitoring social media content for an organization, as an employee or freelancer. Job Bank files it under professional occupations in advertising, marketing and public relations (NOC 11202).

records.name: Spreadsheet & data clean-up freelancing (category)
records.summary: Freelance work tidying, entering and organizing business data in spreadsheets: removing duplicates, fixing formats, building simple formulas and reports.

records.name: Temporary placements through staffing agencies (office/admin and general)
records.summary: Licensed temp and staffing agencies (e.g., Randstad, Adecco, Robert Half) place workers in short-term or contract roles, including office and admin work that is occasionally partly remote.

records.name: Statistics Canada data collection clerk (survey interviewer)
records.summary: Statistics Canada hires data collection clerks as needed, for up to 35 hours a week, to run survey interviews, mostly by phone, from home or on-site.

records.name: Part-time online rater / evaluator (TELUS Digital AI Community)
records.organization: TELUS Digital AI Community (formerly TELUS International AI)
records.summary: TELUS Digital's AI Community hires people living in Canada as part-time freelancers to evaluate search, media and online-safety content from home.

records.name: Freelance bug-hunting tester (Test IO)
records.summary: Free crowdtesting platform that pays testers per accepted bug or test for exploratory testing of apps and websites.

records.name: Freelance software tester, paid hourly (Testlio)
records.summary: Managed crowdtesting company that pays vetted freelance testers by the hour for client test runs, with occasional Canada-specific projects.

records.name: Toronto Public Library free online courses (LinkedIn Learning, IT skills)
records.summary: With a free Toronto Public Library card you can take online courses (LinkedIn Learning, Let's Learn Tech IT training, Brainfuse workplace tech skills, Gale Courses) at no cost.

records.name: Freelance transcriptionist (short audio clips)
records.summary: Transcribe short audio clips on TranscribeMe's WorkHub platform after passing an entrance exam, paid per audio hour via PayPal.

records.name: Work-from-home customer service representative (TTEC Canada)
records.summary: TTEC, a large outsourced customer-service company, posts permanent work-from-home phone and chat support jobs for Canadian residents, usually limited to certain provinces.

records.name: Paid university research studies (University of Toronto participant pools)
records.organization: University of Toronto (psychology departments and labs)
records.summary: Sign up to University of Toronto participant registries to be contacted for paid psychology studies; occasional research participation, not a job.
audience: People who can get to a University of Toronto campus

records.name: Freelance client work through Upwork
records.summary: Sell services to clients by sending proposals for projects posted on Upwork's freelance marketplace.

records.name: Paid user research sessions (User Interviews)
records.summary: Apply to occasional paid product-research sessions (interviews, surveys, tests) run by companies; this is research participation, not a job.

records.name: Website and app tester (UserTesting contributor)
records.summary: Get paid small amounts to try websites and apps while speaking your thoughts aloud on a screen recording; occasional paid tests, not a job.

records.name: Freelance crowd software tester (uTest / Applause)
records.summary: Free-to-join tester community where you accept paid invitations to find bugs and run test cases on clients' apps and websites.

records.name: Video, audio & podcast editing (category)
records.summary: Editing video and audio, from short social clips to podcasts, as an employee or freelancer. Job Bank groups video and sound editors with audio and video recording technicians (NOC 52113).

records.name: Virtual assistant / administrative support (category)
records.summary: Remote administrative support, such as inbox, calendar, documents, CRM upkeep and follow-ups, done for one employer or for several clients from home.

records.name: Search quality rater – English (Canada) (Welo Data / Welocalize)
records.summary: Freelance, remote role rating search-engine results for relevance and quality, for people located in Canada working 10–20 hours a week.

records.name: Freelance translator / localization linguist
records.summary: Join Welocalize's freelance talent community to receive translation, review and quality-check work in your language pairs, such as English–Canadian French.

records.name: On-demand work-at-home contact centre agent (Working Solutions)
records.summary: Working Solutions contracts independent agents in the US and Canada to handle customer calls for client programs from home, paid per productive minute.

records.name: Young Canada Works student jobs in heritage
records.summary: Federally funded summer and student jobs at museums, archives, libraries and heritage sites for students aged 16–30. You apply to employers through the Young Canada Works portal.

records.name: Remote virtual executive assistant (Zirtual)
records.summary: Zirtual matches experienced virtual executive assistants in the US or Canada with busy professionals as independent contractors.
